* Health insurance, 401(K), PTO, clinic treatment discounts

jobs.title: Population Health & Sustainability Lead
jobs.description:
The UCSF Center for Advancing Dyadic Care in Pediatrics (CADP) is looking for an experienced professional and leader with a background in population health, managed care quality, and Medicaid financing who has a passion for public health, particularly when it comes to the intersection of mental health, social justice, and pediatric health care.


This position will serve as the Lead for the Population Health, Quality \& Sustainability Strategy Workstream for the UCSF Center for Advancing Dyadic Care in Pediatrics (CADP). The workstream lead will focus on how the CADP maximizes impact, scale, and long term sustainability. The role will be responsible for supporting partnerships with key stakeholders and partners, including California Managed Care Plans and government organizations, such as the California Department of Health Care Services, where they will draw upon their skills and expertise in health center operations , population health strategy, and Medicaid policy and finance to advance the objectives of the workstream. This key workstream joins five other leads of distinct workstreams and a dynamic, mission\-driven staff to collaboratively advance the vision of the UCSF CADP, which is to make family\-centered, dyadic behavioral health promotion and prevention a routine and sustainable standard of pediatric health care in early childhood. This role will focus primarily on scale, spread, and sustainability of dyadic services in California, integrating expertise in operations, policy, and payment to inform the CADP strategy of promoting utilization and implementation of new Dyadic Services Medi\-Cal Benefit (created as part of the Governor’s Children and Youth Behavioral Health Initiative). This position is critical to supporting population health, community, provider, and government stakeholders in implementing dyadic care services.


Working closely with UCSF CADP executive leadership to guide strategic goals and objectives, the Workstream Lead will function autonomously and as part of a team to develop, manage, and track deliverables from the Population Health, Quality, and Sustainability Strategy workstream. They will rely on best practices for innovating practice change and improvements, and promoting improved access to care. They will develop, oversee, and supervise the work of the Population Health, Quality and Sustainability Workstream, including a quality and sustainability specialist and a project manager in implementation of the workstream goals. This position is responsible for:


* Population health strategy
* Systems transformation
* Financial sustainability strategy
* Managed care strategy
* Quality improvement framework development
* Dissemination strategy
* Scaling and spread strategy
* Policy analysis, translation, and advocacy
* Serve as a consultant in improvement efforts

The Population Health \& Sustainability Lead represents an exciting opportunity to work closely with cross\-sector community, public health, government, and healthcare finances partnerships to promote and expand access to family\-centered, preventative behavioral health care for infants and young children. The ideal candidate will have experience working in Medicaid managed care settings and interfacing with fast\-paced hospital or public health settings, familiarity with common health and process outcome metrics, and is comfortable working with multiple stakeholders from a variety of backgrounds (clinical, public health, community\-based organizations, and patient stakeholders). The ideal candidate will be able to function both independently and as part of a team. It is preferred that the candidate have experience with managed care plans, pediatric health care, early childhood health and mental health, and public health financing .


  
Required Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in related area and minimum five years of experience or equivalent experience / training.
* Minimum 3 years experience supervising staff in carrying out operational goals
* Minimum 3 years experience in population health or related Medicaid quality experience
* Thorough knowledge of organization or initiative processes, protocols and procedures.
* Solid knowledge of / common organizational\- or research\-specific computer application programs.
* Strong analytical / problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate and influence others, both verbally and in writing.
* Advanced project management skills.
* Ability to multi\-task with demanding timeframes.
* Ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
* Solid knowledge of applicable policy analysis techniques.
  

Preferred Qualifications


* Healthcare leader with high degree of technical expertise in Medi\-Cal managed care operations, such as programs CalAIM, and the Children \& Youth Behavioral Health Initiative
* Education and training expertise and experience
* Business development knowledge
* Minimum 5 years experience in public health or Medicaid\-related work
* Advanced degree preferred.

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. jobs.description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**YOUR ROLE**

Be the primary interface between customers and ST for operational communications, demand fulfillment, forecast alignment, supply execution and service performance through best\-in\-class customer service.


Pro\-actively act as the official and reliable information source for customer demand and execution constraints.  



**Customer orders \& executions management**

* Manage order lifecycle (firm orders, NRE POs, samples), including contract and pricing set up
* Maintain and optimize backlog: update requests, monitor confirmations \& deliveries. Capture customer signals to improve forecast accuracy, as applicable.
* Ensure adherence to the agreed terms (RD changes, inventory control) and drive issue resolution working with divisions and supply chain organizations
* Provide the short\-term manufacturing request through customer delivery forecasts, operational demand management, complimenting customer POs, as applicable.
* Achieve revenue plans by driving optimal backlog coverage, working in close partnership with the customer, sales and champions
* Support billing and shipping requirements in coordination with Finance, Logistics, and Trade Compliance
* Ensure disciplined last\-mile execution to achieve quarter\-end billing targets (e.g. JIT, DSI)

**Supply \& Logistics Management**

* Translate key supply drivers (internal/ external inventory, GITs, constrained demand, PLDs, demand layering) into a clear and reliable supply commitment to customer through capacity visibility, quality service setup, and in alignment with sourcing agreement obligations.
* Manage consignment and buffer stock agreement (VMI contracts, LTI agreements)

* Proactively manage shipment risks: resolve delays, expedite urgent shipments, address customs issues, and manage trade compliance requirements

* Oversee customer set up, following the governance standards and customer requirements

**Customer communication \& Escalation**

* Lead customer communication on operational topics (lead\-time, delivery status, improvement)
* Support direct customer or distributor inquiries (claims, RMAs, compliance data, documentation)
* Partner closely with the respective sales team, manage escalations, ensuring timely resolution through prompt communication

**Capacity \& Constraint Outlook**

* Develop and communicate forward\-looking supply outlooks aligned with allocation and capacity
* Define mitigation strategies and product mix scenarios during constraints

**YOUR SKILLS \& EXPERIENCES**

* Experienced operations leader with 10\-15 years of expertise in sales processes, demand and supply management, and customer service
* Strong understanding of supply chain principles, processes, and best practices, with the ability to support efficient planning, coordination, and execution across the value chain.
* Collaborative partner with business operations, sales, finance, divisions, and supply chain teams.
* Strong communication skills
* Problem solving skills

At STMicroelectronics, base salary is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range depending on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.


The base annual salary range for this role is between $132,800\- $166,000 USD


ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.


At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.  



To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

jobs.description:
Nestled in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood on a nine\-acre campus, the San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (SFCJL) is the leading senior services organization in Northern California. Our continuum of care includes: the Frank Residences assisted living and memory care; the Jewish Home and Rehabilitation Center, offering long\-term skilled nursing, short\-term rehabilitation, an acute geriatric psychiatric unit for adults over the age of 65; and our Foundation.



Founded in 1871 and formerly known as the Jewish Home, our legacy grounds us as our vision propels us forward. Today, we've evolved to support more than 2,500 older adults each year through innovative, comprehensive programs rooted in the Jewish values of compassion, community, and excellence. We are equally proud of our inclusive culture, where 950 team members of diverse faiths and backgrounds work together in shared purpose.


**WHY WORK WITH US**


* Mission\-driven nonprofit organization
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
* Meaningful work that positively impacts the lives of older adults every day
* Inclusive community, welcoming to all (you do not need to be Jewish to live or work here)
* Supportive, team\-oriented environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and development
* Collaborative leadership focused on enhancing the employee experience
**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The Learning and Development Manager is a newly created position within the Human Resources Department responsible for building and leading an organization\-wide learning and development function.



This role develops, implements, facilitates, and evaluates learning strategies and programs that strengthen employee capability, leadership effectiveness, regulatory readiness, performance, engagement, and succession planning. The Manager partners closely with executive and department leaders to assess organizational and role\-specific learning needs and translate those needs into practical, measurable development solutions. This position also supports a culture of continuous learning by coordinating required and role\-specific education, strengthening manager and supervisor capability, and ensuring learning programs align with organizational priorities, applicable regulatory requirements, resident\-centered service standards, and the needs of a diverse workforce.



The Learning and Development Manager owns the learning lifecycle, from needs assessment and instructional design through delivery, measurement, continuous improvement, vendor management, and learning technology administration, and uses data to demonstrate program effectiveness and business impact.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Develop and execute a comprehensive, organization\-wide learning and development strategy aligned with strategic priorities, workforce needs, organizational values, and employee development goals.
* Conduct organization\-wide and department\-level training needs assessments using performance data, compliance requirements, employee feedback, leadership input, and operational trends.
* Design, develop, facilitate, and continuously improve instructor\-led, virtual, blended, and e\-learning programs using adult learning and instructional design principles.
* Lead leadership and management development programs including foundational supervisor training, coaching skills, performance management, communication, employee relations fundamentals, and leadership effectiveness.
* Partner with HR and operational leaders to support talent development, career pathways, succession planning, high\-potential development, and workforce capability planning.
* Establish and maintain an annual learning calendar and governance process that prioritizes enterprise, department, compliance, and leadership\-development needs.
* Oversee learning management systems, including course assignments, completion tracking, reporting, content governance, user experience, and data integrity.
* Partner with appropriate subject\-matter experts to coordinate and track required training and education applicable to the organization, workforce, and healthcare environment.
* Collaborate with department heads to create consistent onboarding and new\-hire learning frameworks that support successful integration, role readiness, organizational culture, and retention.
* Develop meaningful learning metrics and dashboards; evaluate participation, knowledge transfer, behavior change, compliance, employee experience, and organizational impact, and recommend improvements based on results.
* Manage the L\&D budget, external vendors, consultants, training contracts, and learning resources to maximize quality, value, and organizational impact.
* Stay current on learning technologies, instructional design practices, workforce\-development trends, and relevant senior living/healthcare training requirements and incorporate appropriate best practices.
* Develop and maintain training standards, templates, facilitator guides, learning materials, and documentation to promote consistency and quality.
* Facilitate learning sessions for employees and leaders and coach internal subject\-matter experts and facilitators on effective training delivery.
* Promote an inclusive learning environment and incorporate accessibility, cultural responsiveness, and equitable development opportunities into learning programs.
* Support change\-management initiatives by developing communication, education, and adoption strategies for organizational changes, new systems, policies, and processes.
* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.


**JOB DETAILS**  

* Pay Rate: $120,000 \- $150,000 annually
* Hours: Full\-Time
* Shift Schedule: Day
* Working Days: Monday through Friday

jobs.title: Business Analyst, MDO
jobs.description:
**Our values start with our people, join a team that values you!**


Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off\-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high\-quality brands and on\-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.


As part of our team, you will experience:

* **Success**. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
* **Career growth**. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow
* **Teamwork**. We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution
* **Our commitment to Diversity, Equality \& Inclusion, and our community.** We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.

  

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2023 revenues of $20\.4 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

### **About this opportunity...**

**This role will support the MDO vision to be the central point of contact for all master data needs within a certain data domain (i.e., Supplier, Location Hierarchy, Merchant and Buyer Hierarchies). Partnering with both their direct supervisor (Lead) and department Manager, the Business Analyst will ensure that all requests are prioritized, addressed and resolved in a timely manner. The role is responsible for:*** Managing enterprise data in the MDM system and tools (data management includes review, entry, audit) while working directly with business areas and partner departments.
* Working on assignments (data review and entry in workflows), projects and problems of limited to medium scope in partnership with project or department leadership.
* Partnering with their Supervisor, the role will ensure that all requests are prioritized, addressed and resolved in a timely manner.
* Continually build on content knowledge for data management and processes.
* Provide governance documentation or process documentation.
* Analysis of data; or to provide business insights via metrics or training.
### **What you will do and what you will learn...**

**SME and Point of Contact for Business*** As point of contact for multiple business departments across the organization, the Business Analyst will play an important role to support multiple business units, address regular requests, and troubleshoot issues.
* Analyze data to troubleshoot or provide data insights and business visibility.
* Become the subject matter expert for Supplier, Org, and Location Master’s business use.
**Documentation*** Ensure that existing governance and process documents are up to date based on changes in requirements or business needs.
* Create and maintain a library of all training materials and guides.
**Request Management*** Manage workflow and requests in a Master Data Management Tool. Execute on all (change) requests from business effectively to ensure that they are implemented according to set data governance standards and processes.
 **Process Improvement/Projects*** Identify and provide recommendations on ways to better service the business.
 **Compliance and Adoption*** Verify all Master Data Management processes around data governance are followed.
* Play an integral role in escalating requests that do not comply with the governance set by MDO.
* Be Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all Ross specific data management and processes.
* Build deep content knowledge around how the business end\-users use this foundational data to run the business.
### **What you need to be successful...**

* Bachelor’s Degree with a concentration in Business, Economics, Finance, HR, or Computer Science, or an equivalent diploma
* 3\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, (preferably in Retail or in an IT field), with strong process, data, and systems understanding
* Prior Data Governance and Administration experience or exposure preferred
* Thorough knowledge of business process documentation that includes prior experience with documenting Merchandising, IT or Finance workflows, processes and requirements
* Ability to work with both business (non\-technical) and IT (technical) with ability to communicate/translate requirements easily and effectively between all parties
* Strong understanding of productivity suite software (i.e., Microsoft Office)
* Ability to understand and apply instructions or suggest alternate proven methods to move projects or requests forward
* Strong analytical skills
* Ability to follow established practices, policies and procedures
* Strong communication skills
* Ability to build working relationships and bring about cooperation from leadership and working teams
* Ability to adjust with changing work environments, priorities and goals
**Perks and Benefits of joining our team...**


Our Associates are at the heart of everything we do and we're proud to offer a range of benefits that reflect how much we value their contributions. Here's a peek into what you can expect as an eligible Ross Associate:

* A broad range of affordable health insurance options \& personal medical plan concierge  

401(k) with employer match and Life insurance
* Ample PTO including accrued vacation, paid holidays, diversity day, summer Fridays and the ability to purchase additional vacation.
* Employee stock purchase plan\*
* Access to health and wellness benefits such as BetterHelp and Headspace
* Charitable donations matched by Ross Stores Foundation
* And more....
* benefits vary by level and position and are subject to change

  

DISCLAIMER


This job description is a summary

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Agentic Change Enablement
jobs.description:
**About Egen:**

Egen is a fast\-growing and entrepreneurial company with a data\-first mindset. We bring together the best engineering talent working with the most advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. We are committed to being a place where the best people choose to work so they can apply their engineering and technology expertise to envision what is next for how data and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving tough problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If this describes you, we want you on our team.

*Want to learn more about life at Egen? Check out these resources in addition to the job description.*

* \> Meet Egen


* \> Life at Egen


* \> Culture and Values at Egen


* \> Career Development at Egen



### **Role Overview:**


Egen is looking for a strategic and client\-facing Senior Consultant, Agentic Change Enablement to lead high\-impact transformations. This role serves as the human\-side anchor on engagements where technology is only part of the story. You will embed with client project teams to ensure employees at every level are prepared, equipped, and motivated to adopt new ways of working powered by Google Cloud, Gemini, and the emerging "agentic work" paradigm. Reporting to the Senior Director, you will be responsible for activating and scaling our delivery playbook to foster deep organizational alignment and tangible business outcomes.
### **About the job:**


#### **1\. Agentic Change Strategy \& Planning**


* Framework Application: Apply structured change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) to design tailored strategies for complex AI and Workspace transformations.
* Discovery \& Assessment: Facilitate Gemini Enterprise Discovery Workshops and conduct change impact analyses to identify risks, gaps, and "agentic" opportunities.
* Outcome Definition: Define "North Star" outcomes and success metrics (KPIs) to track adoption progress and organizational health.
* Impact Mapping: Document key policy and process impact changes resulting from the integration of AI into daily operating rhythms.

#### **2\. Stakeholder Engagement \& Executive Advisory**


* Executive Coaching: Support and engage senior leaders and executive sponsors, coaching them on their visible change leadership role.
* Resistance Management: Anticipate and proactively manage resistance to AI, developing targeted mitigation strategies for high\-risk stakeholder groups.
* Champion Activation: Build and activate "Gemini Captain" (Change Champion) networks to amplify adoption at scale through peer\-to\-peer learning.
* Translation: Serve as a natural "bridge," translating complex technical AI concepts into compelling business value and strategic imperatives.

#### **3\. Training, Education \& Communication**


* Curriculum Design: Develop persona\-based learning journeys and role\-based training programs that build competency in agentic solutions.
* Narrative Development: Create compelling change narratives that frame AI\-driven efficiencies as an opportunity for workforce evolution, not replacement.
* Asset Creation: Leverage Google Workspace tools (Slides, Sites, Docs, Vids) to produce high\-quality enablement assets, including leader toolkits and prompt libraries.
* Workshop Facilitation: Design and lead "Art of the Possible" kickoffs and dynamic design\-thinking sessions using tools like Miro or Mural.

#### **4\. Adoption Measurement \& Sustainment**


* Pilot Implementation: Lead Gemini Enterprise Pilot programs, managing Vanguard Cohorts and capturing baseline productivity reports.
* Support Infrastructure: Establish multi\-layered support systems, including Slack/Teams channels, office hours, and deployed self\-service support agents.
* Sustainment: Conduct post\-go\-live reinforcement activities and pulse check surveys to embed new behaviors permanently.
* Reporting: Generate weekly usage and adoption reports for project stakeholders and client leadership.
### **About you:**


#### **Required**


* Experience: 3–6\+ years in organizational change management or management consulting, with a focus on enterprise\-scale technology programs.
* Methodology: Proven proficiency with change management frameworks; Prosci (ADKAR) certification is strongly preferred.
* Technology Background: Experience supporting cloud or SaaS adoption programs (Google Workspace, Google Cloud, or equivalent).
* Communication: Exceptional skills in crafting narratives and presenting to everyone from end users to C\-suite executives.
* Engagement: Strong stakeholder management capabilities with experience influencing across complex organizations.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Organizational Development, Business, Psychology, Communications, or a related field.

#### **Preferred**


* AI Expertise: Hands\-on experience with Generative AI adoption (e.g., Gemini for Google Workspace or Vertex AI).
* Partner Experience: Prior experience at a Google Cloud Premier Partner or technology consulting firm.
* Technical Literacy: Ability to collaborate with technical workstreams (engineers, data scientists) to translate technical change into human\-centered action.
* Measurement: Experience building adoption dashboards and reporting metrics to leadership.
* Workshop Mastery: Extensive experience running dynamic strategy workshops both in\-person and with tools like Miro or Mural.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Insights Program Management
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Senior Manager, Implementation Program Manager to own the delivery and relationship for a portfolio of Tendo Insights customers, from contract signature through go\-live and into steady\-state value realization. You'll be the person a hospital's CMO, CFO, and clinical documentation team all trust to bring order to a complex, cross\-functional rollout — one that touches clinical, financial, IT, and executive stakeholders who don't always agree with each other.



This is a senior, largely autonomous role. You'll be expected to build and run your own implementation plans, manage multiple concurrent customer engagements, navigate organizational politics inside customer accounts, and represent Tendo credibly in front of hospital executives while also partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Support to make sure customer commitments are realistic and kept.  

  

**About Tendo**



Make an impact—join our team!  

  

We’re a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company building a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive. **Our team\-driven culture and rapid growth have** **earned us recognition as one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers for 2024, 2025, and 2026\.** Led by an experienced and proven team, we live by our values and are always on the hunt for motivated people with diverse experiences and backgrounds to help us improve the care journey for patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user\-friendly experiences.  

  

If you like working with innovative technologies and want to be part of a growing team that will help transform the healthcare experience, we encourage you to apply today!  

  

**Job Location**



Remote



Tendo has hubs in San Francisco, CA; Salt Lake City, UT; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and Philadelphia, PA. Candidates may be located in any one of our hub locations.



\#LI\-Remote



### **Responsibilities**


* Own end\-to\-end implementation planning for new Tendo Insights customers — building phased project plans, governance structures, and realistic timelines based on each customer's specific data, IT, and organizational constraints.
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts through implementation, building trusted\-advisor relationships with executive sponsors (CMO/CFO\-level), day\-to\-day champions, and operational stakeholders (CDI, HIM, IT/data teams).
* Identify and proactively manage delivery risk — including organizational and interpersonal risk (e.g., a stakeholder who sees the tool as a threat, competing internal IT priorities) and not just timeline/technical risk.
* Run structured stakeholder communication and escalation cadences, including managing engagements through periods when an executive sponsor has reduced availability.
* Convert high\-level or phased contract commitments into specific, mutually agreed implementation plans with the customer.Build and deliver executive\-level updates and business reviews that connect implementation progress to the value the customer actually cares about — including proposing credible leading indicators when the metrics customers ultimately care about (like annual quality rankings) move too slowly to show in\-quarter progress.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales (on scoping and handoff), Product (on customer feedback and gaps), and Support (on transition to steady state) to ensure a seamless customer experience.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer engagements at varying stages of the implementation lifecycle, prioritizing your time across a portfolio rather than a single account.
* Mentor and provide guidance to more junior program/project managers on the team as it scales.
### **Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in program/project management, implementation, or professional services, ideally in enterprise software, healthcare technology, or a comparably complex B2B environment.
* A track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder implementations with executive\-level customer visibility — not just internal project plans.
* Demonstrated judgment in navigating organizational politics and relationship risk within a customer account — you can name the real risk to an engagement, not just the risk that's easy to put in a status report.
* Strong executive communication and presence — comfortable building and delivering a plan or business review directly to a customer's C\-suite, and comfortable being challenged on it in the room.
* Structured, rigorous planning skills: you can build a realistic, dependency\-aware timeline rather than a generic template.
* Experience managing a portfolio of concurrent engagements and prioritizing across competing demands.
### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in healthcare — particularly with hospital or health system operations, clinical quality programs, clinical documentation improvement (CDI), or healthcare data/analytics.
* Familiarity with healthcare quality metrics and ranking programs (e.g., CMS Star Ratings, U.S. News \& World Report rankings, HEDIS, or similar).
* PMP, PgMP, or similar program management certification.
* Experience partnering with clinical, IT, and finance stakeholders simultaneously on the same engagement.

  


**Base Salary Range**



$114,750 \- $155,250



This salary range is offered with the understanding that final compensation is based on a number of factors including geography and experience. Tendo also offers an equity package, annual bonuses, and benefits.

  


**Benefits**



For full time employees, Tendo also offers full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending and health savings accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short\-term and long\-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k), company paid holidays, flexible time off, and an employee wellness program (“Breathe”).

jobs.description:
**Summary**  



The Service Delivery Manager (“SDM”) serves as the primary customer success leader for assigned Managed Services clients. Responsible for service performance, billing, governance, and continuous improvement, the SDM translates operational delivery into meaningful business outcomes by fostering executive relationships, proactively managing customer health, and ensuring customers realize maximum value from their partnership with Logicalis.

**Customer Success \& Relationship Management**


* Serve as the primary operational relationship owner and trusted partner for assigned Managed Services customers, maintaining a deep understanding of customer business objectives , service requirements, stakeholder dynamics, strategic initiatives, risks, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with executive sponsors, business stakeholders, and operational leaders to foster alignment, trust, and long\-term partnership success.
* Align service delivery, governance activities, and continuous improvement efforts to customer priorities, business objectives , and desired outcomes.
* Manage customer expectations through proactive communication, effective service governance, stakeholder engagement, and transparent management of risks, issues, and service performance.

* Own the overall delivery experience for assigned customers, ensuring services are delivered in accordance with contractual commitments and customer expectations.
* Review, analyze, and communicate Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance, service trends, and areas requiring improvement.

* Manage client\-facing change governance processes, ensuring customer satisfaction, communication, and contractual integrity are maintained .
* Oversee execution and delivery of Event Analysis Reports, Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), and other service\-impacting event communications.
* Serve as the primary communication focal point during major service\-impacting incidents and escalations.

**Customer Health, Risk \& Escalation Management**


* Proactively monitor customer health, identify risks, and develop mitigation plans.
* Lead customer escalation management efforts, coordinating cross\-functional teams through issue resolution and communication.

* Collaborate with Logicalis support teams, Service Desk, NOC, Security Operations, Solution Architects, Professional Services, Account Executives, Customer Success leaders, and Managed Services staff to shape and deliver customer outcomes.

* Lead efforts associated with onboarding new customers and integrating new services, devices, technologies, and delivery capabilities into existing customer environments.
* Enable service delivery through ownership and maintenance of customer\-specific ServiceNow documentation, governance records, and operational artifacts.

* Support customer retention, renewal readiness, and long\-term partnership success through proactive engagement and demonstrated value realization.
**Compliance \& Professional Standards**


* Maintain working knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local laws, regulations, and Logicalis policies and procedures.

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

==================================

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The company serves more than 4,000 financial institutions throughout North America, operating with velocity to help our clients keep pace with the rapid momentum of change and fuel growth in the new era of financial services. The **Contact Center Commercial Performance Manager** serves as a strategic business partner and primary analytical resource for Contact Center service economics, profitability analysis, service model design, and pricing evaluations. This role is responsible for analyzing the financial, operational, and commercial performance of the Contact Center business; supporting financial planning, forecasting, profitability management, business performance reporting, and commercial decision\-making; and developing financial and service economics models that support Contact Center offerings, client solutions, and commercial structures. Working closely with Contact Center leadership, Finance, Commercial Operations, Contracts \& Billing, Proposal Support, and Service Delivery teams, the position provides data\-driven insights, pricing recommendations, profitability assessments, and business case analysis to optimize operational efficiency, support sustainable growth, improve financial performance, and ensure alignment between service offerings, operational execution, and organizational objectives.

STR Operations Manager / Founder’s Right Hand

**Future Director of Operations / GM Opportunity**

**$22–$27/hr \| \~20 Hours/Week to Start \| 90\-Day Paid Trial**

This Is Not a Typical Part\-Time Operations Job

We are looking for an experienced **short\-term rental operator with the ambition and capability to eventually help run multiple growing businesses.**

This position starts part\-time because several of our newest growth initiatives are still ramping.

**The position is not intended to stay small.**

We operate businesses in short\-term rental revenue management, remote STR management, and home services. We have established operations, active leads, new services launching, and significant growth opportunities.

The founder has become too involved in day\-to\-day execution.

We need someone who can eventually become the founder’s **\#2**.

The right person won't simply manage what exists. You'll help us **build and scale what comes next.**

Professional STR Experience Is Required

You should already understand professional STR operations, including:

* Airbnb/Vrbo
* Owner and guest communication
* Property onboarding
* Listing setup/optimization
* Cleaners and maintenance
* PMS platforms such as Guesty, Hospitable, Hostaway, etc.
* PriceLabs or similar dynamic pricing software
* STR performance and revenue\-management fundamentals

Experience professionally operating **20\+ STR properties is strongly preferred**.

We need someone who already understands this industry—not someone we need to teach STR operations from scratch.

What You'll Do

You'll initially work directly with the founder to:

* Coordinate STR client onboarding and operations
* Manage owner communication and routine client issues
* Keep leads, contracts, and onboarding moving
* Coordinate with revenue managers and other team members
* Help manage GoHighLevel CRM and automations
* Improve listings and operational processes
* Build SOPs and scalable systems
* Track KPIs and identify problems
* Follow up with employees and contractors
* Help oversee operations within our home\-services company
* Hold team members accountable
* Solve routine operational problems without involving the founder

Most importantly, you'll help us **scale**.

When we add another 20, 50, or 100 properties, we want you thinking:

**What needs to change? Who do we need? What should we automate? What will break next? How do we grow without creating chaos?**

We don't want to push someone to think this way.

We're looking for someone who naturally does.

Who We're Looking For

You might currently be an STR Operations Manager, Portfolio Manager, Senior Property Manager, or similar professional who knows you're capable of more.

You:

* Take ownership without being chased
* Solve problems before they become emergencies
* Build systems instead of repeatedly fixing the same problem
* Can lead and hold people accountable
* Understand numbers and KPIs
* Communicate professionally with owners
* Make good decisions independently
* Learn technology quickly
* Use automation and AI intelligently
* Think ahead as a company grows
* Want your responsibility and career to grow with the business

We want someone who increasingly tells the founder:

**“I've already handled it.”**

The Upside

Our philosophy is simple:

**The more value you create and the more these businesses grow, the more opportunity there should be for you to grow with them.**

A successful person can progress toward:

**Operations Manager → Director of Operations → General Manager / Founder’s \#2**

That can mean increased hours, compensation, authority, team leadership, and performance\-based compensation opportunities as the role develops.

Advancement isn't automatic. It will be earned through results.

But we are specifically recruiting someone who has the **capability to grow far beyond the starting position.**

Compensation

**$22–$27/hour depending on experience**

Approximately **20 hours/week initially**

**90\-day paid trial**

We will evaluate progress around Days 30, 60, and 90 based on ownership, reliability, problem\-solving, leadership, systems improvement, and how much operational responsibility you've successfully taken from the founder.

Strong performance can lead to increased hours, compensation, responsibility, and a long\-term leadership position.

**We're looking for someone who may eventually become an exceptional operator and business leader.**

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

* How many STR properties have you professionally helped operate, and what were you personally responsible for?
* Why are you interested in a position that starts part\-time but could develop into running a much larger operation?

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.


Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.


We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.


**Applying to Render**
----------------------


We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.


We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.


Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.


**About the Role**
------------------


We’re looking for a Talent Operations Manager to own the systems, data, and operating rhythm behind how Render hires. You’ll architect our ATS, build the reporting that Talent and hiring teams rely on, and lead process changes that help us scale without losing quality.


You’ll work closely with recruiters, recruiting coordinators, hiring managers, People leaders, and external partners. You’ll make sure our hiring data can answer the questions teams need to make better decisions.


This is a high\-leverage role for someone who likes turning messy, fast\-moving work into clear operating systems. You’ll help us reduce process drift, improve candidate and interviewer experience, keep hiring data trustworthy, and give the team better visibility into what is working, what is blocked, and where we need to adjust.


We value people who are practical, systems\-minded, and steady when the work gets complex. The right person can zoom out to design how the system should work, then zoom in to improve the field, report, access role, or automation that is slowing the team down.


**What You’ll Do**
------------------


* Architect how our ATS works across custom fields, access roles, interview plans, feedback forms, automations, integrations, and reporting foundations
* Own the reporting layer for Talent leadership and hiring teams, including dashboards, ad hoc reporting, metric definitions, and visibility into hiring plan progress

* Turn recurring Talent Operations requests into better systems: identify patterns, improve workflows, automate repeatable work, and make the right processes self\-serve

* Lead process rollouts with clear documentation, training, adoption checks, and follow\-through so changes stick

**What We’re Looking For**

* Deep ATS expertise, particularly Ashby. You can design how the system should work, not just maintain it, across custom fields, access roles, interview plans, automations, integrations, and reporting foundations
* Strong analytical skills. You can take a vague question, decide what data would answer it, and build the report yourself
* Proficient in Google Sheets or Excel. You can pull data together from multiple sources and turn the result into a case a cross\-functional partner can follow

* Strong program and change management skills. You can roll out a new process, teach it, measure adoption, and keep the team aligned
* Clear written communication, strong documentation habits, high attention

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.  

  

We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.  

  

### **Role**

  

  

The **Revenue Accounting Project Manager** will help build and standardize how Function Health's revenue accounting function operates — the processes it runs on and the systems that support them — without performing the close itself. This role sits at the intersection of accounting, process design, and cross\-functional execution: you'll understand accounting treatment well enough to shape sound requirements and standards, and you'll project\-manage the work needed to get there, in service of a team that owns the close.  

  

You'll work across multiple revenue streams, each with its own systems, maturity level, and open questions. You'll support the team's initiative roadmap by surfacing where a process or control needs attention, then take ownership of sequencing, scoping, and driving that work to a documented, repeatable outcome. That often involves systems and data, but just as often it's about establishing how something should work as a matter of process, independent of any one tool. The ideal candidate has an accounting background and can speak the language fluently, but is energized by building the structure around accounting rather than executing the close itself. You're naturally curious, comfortable digging into ambiguity to find the root cause of a problem, and able to independently manage a project from open questions to a finished, standardized process.  

  

You will report to the **Senior Revenue Accounting Manager,** and operate with a high degree of autonomy on your workstreams while receiving direction on priorities and judgment calls. This is a strong fit for someone who wants ownership over how the function's processes and initiatives take shape — bringing forward what they're noticing, flagging what doesn't make sense, and driving cross\-functional projects to completion with minimal oversight once scoped.  

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

  

* **Support the Senior Manager in shaping the accounting initiative roadmap** — surfacing process gaps, risks, and opportunities, then owning the scoping and prioritization of your workstreams once direction is set.
* **Design and standardize accounting processes and controls across revenue streams** — independent of any single system — so operations run consistently and predictably as the business scales.
* **Own end\-to\-end project management for revenue accounting initiatives** — scoping requirements, sequencing workstreams, tracking open items across stakeholders, and driving projects to completion against a deadline.
* **Serve as the connective tissue between Accounting and Data/Engineering, Finance, and Product** — gathering requirements, resolving ambiguity between teams, and ensuring decisions made in one function are accurately reflected in another.
* Translate accounting treatment and technical judgment into system requirements and configuration logic for ERP/revenue recognition systems, partnering with implementation teams and internal engineering resources.
* **Investigate data quality and process breakdowns by working directly with underlying datasets** — tracing issues to root cause rather than reconciling around them, and partnering with Data/Engineering to fix them at the source.
* Build and maintain documentation, mapping logic, and handoff materials that convert undocumented or ad hoc knowledge into clear, auditable procedures the accounting team can run against.
* Prepare clear, organized documentation and data support for external audit and advisory partners on request, without owning the audit relationship directly.
  

  

### **Qualifications/Skills**

  

  

* 7\+ years of progressive experience spanning accounting and either project management, business/systems analysis, or accounting operations; ***Big 4 public accounting experience is strongly preferred.***
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Solid understanding of **US GAAP and ASC 606** revenue recognition, including application to subscription or service\-based revenue models — strong enough to shape sound requirements and standards, even without performing the close.
* Demonstrated project management skills — able to independently scope, sequence, and drive a cross\-functional initiative to completion.
* Experience designing or standardizing operational processes and controls, not just exe

#### **About Melita**



For more than 30 years, Melita Group has helped small and mid\-sized employers solve the complexity of HR, Employee Benefits, and Payroll. We combine deep expertise with a modern technology platform to deliver outsourced services that let our clients focus on growing their businesses while we handle the operational backbone of their workforce. We are a results\-driven, high\-integrity organization that holds itself accountable to its promises, and our clients stay with us for years, often decades, because we treat their success as our own. As we scale, we are investing heavily in technology, automation, and AI to raise the bar on what an HR outsourcing partner can deliver.


#### **The Opportunity**



Every new client relationship begins with implementation, and the quality of that experience sets the trajectory for retention, expansion, and reference\-ability for years to come. The Implementation Specialist is a hands\-on role that supports bringing complex HR, benefits, and payroll clients live on our platform. You will do the configuration, data migration, and testing yourself, not just manage it from a distance.



Reporting to the Head of Implementations, you will support onboardings end to end and be the connective tissue that ensures what was sold is what gets delivered. This role is ideal for someone who has implemented outsourced Payroll and HR services at a PEO, an HRO, or an HRIS technology vendor, and who wants to do the work, contribute to the outcome, and help shape how we implement as we scale.

#### **Client Implementations (hands\-on)**


* Support and help execute new client onboardings across HR administration, payroll, benefits, and leave of absence services, from kickoff to a clean handoff to the ongoing service teams.
* Contribute directly to the outcomes that matter: time to live, client satisfaction at go\-live, and a smooth transition to Service Delivery.
* Help build and maintain the implementation project plan, support progress against milestones, and help keep every workstream on schedule.

#### **Platform Configuration, Data Migration, and Integrations (hands\-on)**


* Configure the client's HRIS and complete the build yourself on platforms including ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, and Rippling, and in our Salesforce environment.

* Work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Client Success, Service Delivery, Product, and Finance to align on client expectations, scope, pricing assumptions, and post\-implementation transitions.

#### **AI, Automation, and Continuous Improvement**


* Identify and champion opportunities to apply AI, automation, and modern tooling to implementation workflows. This is a priority investment area for Melita.
* Document and improve implementation workflows so each onboarding is faster and cleaner than the last.

#### **What We Are Looking For**


* Very strong, hands\-on experience supporting and implementing outsourced Payroll and HR services, ideally gained at a PEO, an HRO, or an HRIS technology vendor that installs a full HRIS together with outsourced services.
* Hands\-on HRIS implementation experience on one or more major platforms (ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, or Rippling), including configuration and data migration.
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience, multi\-state processing, tax setup, and mid\-year conversions with YTD balancing
* A proven track record running end\-to\-end implementations and managing a project plan across multiple workstreams and deadlines.

* Excellent communication skills and a high\-integrity, client\-first approach.

At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission\-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. Our expertise spans AI/ML, data architecture, low\-code/no\-code development, Agile DevSecOps, and cloud services, delivering scalable and meaningful solutions.



In our Emerging Technology Lab, innovation drives progress. Our teams create intelligent chatbots, AI\-powered assistants, robotic process automation (RPA), essay graders, and data analytics platforms. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission\-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70\+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  


**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  


**POSITION SUMMARY**

  


The eLearning Project Manager will plan, lead, and control the development of online learning modules supporting training modernization. This role will manage authorized eLearning work from requirements and design through development, accessibility review, client network and LMS testing, acceptance, and delivery of complete Government\-owned source files and SCORM packages. Working with client stakeholders and APV's instructional design, eLearning, multimedia, graphics, technical writing, quality assurance, and Section 508 personnel, the manager will coordinate multiple concurrent course workstreams and ensure that each product is accurate, engaging, evidence\-based, accessible, maintainable, and aligned with applicable regulatory training systems and National Curriculum Standard requirements.

  

**DUTIES**

  


* Lead authorized eLearning and online\-module projects from initiation through final acceptance, establishing scope, responsibilities, milestones, dependencies, review gates, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate client direction, course evaluation findings, approved Course Development Plans, Course Design Documents, and\-training requirements into executable eLearning production plans and schedules.
* Manage concurrent module\-development workstreams and coordinate instructional designers, eLearning developers, graphic artists, video and multimedia specialists, technical writers, subject matter experts, LMS personnel, and accessibility and quality reviewers.
* Ensure online modules apply evidence\-based instructional design and adult\-learning practices and align objectives, content, interactive activities, games, simulations, practice, and assessments with applicable standards.
* Control scope, schedule, labor, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and changes; identify potential delays or resource constraints early and provide actionable status and recovery recommendations to APV leadership.
* Support project\-level planning and reporting by maintaining accurate eLearning milestones, accomplishments, upcoming work, risks, issues, and client\-directed changes for inclusion in the Program Plan, Monthly Status Reports, and final reporting.
* Facilitate requirements, design, storyboard, prototype, courseware, testing, and acceptance reviews; document decisions and action items, route materials to the appropriate reviewers, and verify incorporation of approved feedback.
* Manage development of SCORM\-compliant modules compatible with the LMS and suitable for use on the client network, coordinating technical requirements and testing with the COR, designated client Project Manager, applicable IT personnel, and LMS administrators.
* Ensure PDF, Word, or PowerPoint source content is provided before SCORM packaging, as required by the SOW, and that HTML\-created source files are not submitted as the required source\-file deliverable.
* Direct functional, instructional, browser and device, network, SCORM, LMS, accessibility, and user\-acceptance testing using traceable requirements and test results; manage defect correction, regression testing, and closure before release.

**Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**


Devoted Medical is building clinical programs to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted's values of treating every member like family. Medication plays a crucial role in helping people manage chronic conditions, but in many cases effective medication management is limited by barriers to access, uncoordinated prescribing, or a failure to use the most effective evidence\-based medication therapies. For example, despite a mountain of evidence, less than 1 in 10 people with congestive heart failure (CHF) are prescribed evidence\-based medications proven to save lives and prevent hospitalizations.


Devoted's clinical pharmacy team aims to support improved therapeutics for Devoted members. It supports this work in three ways:

* *Conducting medication reviews (via direct member engagement and pharmacist consult support for other clinicians)*
* *Virtual pharmacist\-led or clinician\-led care via telemedicine to close therapy gaps*
* *Coordinating care for changes in therapy by counseling members and engaging prescribers and pharmacies*

**This work is done in service of a number of goals. The clinical pharmacy team drives Devoted's quality and Medicare Stars performance across multiple programs such as:**

* **SUPD (Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes)**
* **SPC (Statin Use in Persons with Heart Disease)**
* **MTM (Medication Therapy Management)**
* **TCC (Total Cost of Care)**
* **Polypharmacy**


During appointments with our pharmacists and clinicians, medication opportunities are identified.That's where Pharmacy Care Coordinators (PCCs) step in. PCCs ensure recommendations reach the outside provider, follow up with pharmacies on claims issues, pick\-up confirmations, or discontinuations, and keep the member informed of any changes along the way.


As a PCC, you will partner with our Clinical Pharmacy and Operations teams on outreach, coordination, and follow\-up to provide best in class care to our members, as part of a mission\-driven, team\-oriented, joyful culture.

* Supports clinical outreach campaigns by making outbound calls and utilizing portal chat to members to schedule appointments with the pharmacist team to address clinical gaps or medication concerns

Keeper is hiring a driven Enterprise Account Manager to join our high producing B2B sales division. This can be a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.



Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while expanding and developing client relationships in this pivotal role!


**About Keeper**



Keeper Security is one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero\-knowledge and zero\-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI\-enabled, cloud\-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role\-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just\-in\-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.


**About the Role**



Join an elite group of proven performers. Our team is full of seasoned technologists, with experience selling into SME and Enterprise level accounts. They have a passion for helping companies get the most out of their technology investments and are skilled at identifying new business opportunities and expansion opportunities within named accounts. As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will work with an established client base and be responsible for growing revenue in these accounts using our industry\-leading solutions.


* Thrive in a supportive but independent workplace with the opportunity to grow as our organization grows
* Carry a revenue quota to meet or exceed sales targets within assigned strategic accounts
* Build strong relationships and interact with executives and C\-Level customer contacts
* Work with strategic clients to manage and negotiate contract renewals, cross\-sells and upsells

* Proactively manage the success of a portfolio of assigned Keeper Security customers to deliver consistent value across the entire lifecycle
* Demonstrate knowledge of Customer Success best practices, stay up to date on trends in the industry, and operate as a Customer Success and Cyber Security advisor to your customers
* Understand and navigate account procurement practices to negotiate licensing contracts
* Build strong customer relationships by maintaining high levels of engagement, adoption, and communication; conduct quarterly business reviews to ensure our clients are up to speed on their areas of vulnerability, new product features etc.
* Become a Keeper Security product expert for your customers; occasionally assist on Sales or Marketing calls/webinars as a Strategic Account Executive \& Keeper expert
* Drive customer advocacy in the form of references, referrals, and case studies
* Perform data\-driven reviews and analysis on customer portfolios to prioritize opportunity and risk; reliably renew and expand customer contracts, meeting and exceeding personal and team quotas
* Champion and participate in the evolution of Keeper Security’s own Customer Success programs and processes; insist on excellence in our own Customer Success initiatives
* Contribute towards the development of a strong team environment by upholding high work standards
* Go the extra mile to ensure our customers are supported and successful
* Create and present technical solutions to the C\-Suite and executive boards
* Travel to and from customer meetings (locally and nationally) and rent and/or operate a car on behalf of the company


**Requirements**


* 5\+ years of experience in full cycle or strategic growth SaaS sales; experience with growing enterprise accounts required
* Strong technical knowledge as it pertains to identity management software (SSO, Directory etc), implementation, onboarding \& support
* Motivated by solving problems for customers; demonstrated ability to anticipate challenges before they arise
* Experience working with and selling to enterprise organizations, C\-Level Executives, IT and Cyber Security Executives
* Unrivaled sense of autonomy, ownership, and dedication to helping customers realize their intended value
* Energetic and self\-motivated; a team player who is also a proactive and creative problem solver
* Aptitude for learning software; strong with business applications
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strict attention to details
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal; consistent diplomacy, tact, and poise when working through customer issues and escalations
