jobs.title: Tax Preparer/Office Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Tax Preparer and Office Manager, where you'll play a vital role in delivering exceptional tax services while efficiently managing daily office operations. This energetic position offers the opportunity to utilize your accounting expertise, tax law knowledge, and customer service skills to support clients through complex tax situations and ensure smooth office workflows. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are passionate about helping clients achieve financial clarity, this is the perfect role for you!

**Duties**

* Prepare accurate individual, corporate, partnership, and other tax returns using advanced tax preparation software, ensuring compliance with current tax laws and regulations.
* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the office, including scheduling appointments, overseeing client communications, and maintaining organized records.
* Conduct thorough analysis of financial documents, bookkeeping records, and financial software data such as QuickBooks and Sage to support accurate tax reporting.
* Assist clients with tax planning strategies, providing clear explanations of tax concepts and legal requirements to optimize their financial outcomes.
* Lead client acquisition efforts through marketing initiatives, building strong relationships to expand the client base.
* Ensure timely filing of all tax documents while maintaining high standards of accuracy and confidentiality.
* Support bookkeeping activities and perform technical accounting tasks related to corporate accounting and financial reporting.
* Communicate effectively with clients regarding their tax documents, reports, and any necessary follow\-up actions to enhance customer satisfaction.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in public accounting or a similar role with a focus on individual and corporate tax return preparation.
* Strong knowledge of tax law, compliance procedures, and partnership or corporate tax expertise.
* Proficiency in tax preparation software such as TurboTax, Drake Tax, or similar platforms; experience with accounting software like QuickBooks and Sage is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated skills in financial analysis, math proficiency (including 10\-key typing), and technical accounting practices.
* Excellent customer service skills with the ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly to clients.
* Prior experience in sales or client acquisition strategies is a plus for expanding business opportunities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently while maintaining attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment.

Embrace this opportunity to leverage your accounting talents while leading an energetic office environment! We’re committed to supporting your professional growth through ongoing training in tax laws, software tools, and customer engagement strategies—empowering you to excel every day!

Pay: $300\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Remote Customer Success Representative
jobs.description:
Taranis is an AI\-powered crop intelligence platform helping ag retailers and growers make better agronomic and input decisions through leaf\-level insights and data\-driven recommendations. We work with leading agricultural retailers and crop protection companies across millions of acres in the U.S. and globally.


Our Global Headquarters is in Westfield, Indiana, with our R\&D and Innovation Center in Tel Aviv, Israel. To learn more, visit www.taranis.com.

**The Role**


We are looking for a **highly driven, customer\-focused Customer Success Representative** who takes ownership, operates independently, and gets things done.


You will own the day\-to\-day success and engagement of an assigned customer portfolio, working closely with Regional Account Managers to drive adoption, customer value, retention, renewals, and expansion.


This is a role for someone who is **proactive, accountable, and resourceful** — someone who manages priorities independently, communicates risks early, comes with solutions, and consistently follows through on commitments.


This position is remote within the **Midwest area** and requires periodic travel to customers.

**The Goal of This Role**

* Drive high renewal rates through measurable ROI delivery and consistent customer engagement
* Increase grower enrollment and adoption of Taranis Intelligence programs
* Identify and execute in\-season expansion and upsell opportunities
* Support Regional Account Managers in growing and deepening customer relationships
* Ensure customers successfully operationalize Taranis within their workflows

  


Requirements:
  

* **Agricultural expertise** – 3\+ years of experience in agricultural retail, cooperatives, agronomy, or another customer\-facing agricultural role
* **Agronomic knowledge** – strong understanding of corn and soybean production systems
* **Customer relationship skills** – proven ability to build trusted relationships, drive retention, and communicate value and ROI
* **Ownership \& accountability** – takes responsibility for commitments and consistently follows through
* **Independent execution** – manages multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines effectively with limited oversight
* **Proactive communication** – identifies risks early, keeps stakeholders informed, and communicates before issues escalate
* **Resourcefulness \& problem\-solving** – takes initiative, navigates ambiguity, and brings solutions rather than just problems
* **Drive \& results orientation** – maintains a high standard for performance, customer impact, and execution
* **Flexibility** – willing to travel periodically within the assigned region

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Precision Agriculture or AgTech
* Familiarity with digital agronomy tools, imagery, or data\-driven platforms
* CCA certification
* Experience using Salesforce and Google Workspace

  

Responsibilities:
  

* Partner closely with the Regional Account Manager as the territory’s Customer Success lead
* Serve as the day\-to\-day operational contact for assigned accounts
* Drive pre\-season onboarding, alignment, and expectation setting
* Maintain proactive, high\-touch customer engagement throughout the growing season
* Monitor account health, adoption, and engagement, proactively identifying risks and opportunities
* Deliver ROI reviews and seasonal business summaries to support retention and renewals
* Identify expansion and upsell opportunities and coordinate execution with Regional Account Managers
* Deliver virtual and in\-person trainings, platform walkthroughs, and webinars
* Proactively resolve customer issues with a solutions\-oriented mindset
* Maintain accurate account activity, progress, and renewal status in Salesforce
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Experience, and Flight Operations to ensure seamless execution

  

Why Join Taranis?:  

  

At Taranis, we don’t just innovate — we invest in our people.

* **Empowered by Respect:** We value diverse perspectives and ensure every voice is heard.
* **Driven by Accountability:** Ownership and transparency are foundational to how we work.
* **United in Collaboration:** Cross\-functional teamwork is how we win.
* Dedicated to Commitment: We support flexibility, balance, and long\-term growth.
* **Inspired by Innovation:** We challenge the status quo to advance agriculture globally.


Join Taranis and be part of a team committed to transforming agriculture through technology, sustainability, and measurable impact — for growers, retailers, and the future of farming.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Castle Rock Lawn \& Sprinkler seeks an Accounting Manager with at least four years of relevant experience to manage daily accounting activities and oversee the company’s QuickBooks records.**

Our company provides sprinkler installation, repairs, seasonal maintenance, winterization, and lawn care services. This part\-time remote position supports our operations through customer billing, vendor account management, expense tracking, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

You will work directly with company leadership to maintain accurate financial records, resolve accounting discrepancies, and keep accounting tasks on schedule. The role requires hands\-on QuickBooks experience, including administrative functions, and the ability to work independently.

Responsibilities

* Manage daily accounting activities in QuickBooks, including transaction review, account categorization, and customer and vendor records.
* Maintain the chart of accounts and manage QuickBooks settings and user permissions with company approval.
* Prepare and review invoices for service calls, installations, and maintenance work. Record payments, deposits, credits, and outstanding balances.
* Review vendor bills, verify supporting documentation, and prepare payment schedules for approval.
* Reconcile bank and credit card accounts, investigate discrepancies, and complete month\-end closing tasks.
* Track labor, materials, equipment, and operating expenses to support job costing and profitability reviews.
* Prepare financial statements, accounts receivable and payable reports, and cash flow updates for company leadership.
* Coordinate with office and field staff to verify completed work, resolve billing questions, and obtain missing records.
* Organize payroll information and year\-end accounting records for the payroll provider and external accountant.
* Maintain accounting procedures, follow payment approval requirements, and protect confidential financial information.

Required Qualifications

* At least four years of accounting experience with responsibility for accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Strong QuickBooks proficiency and experience independently managing daily accounting records.
* Experience with QuickBooks administrative functions, including company settings, user permissions, and chart of accounts maintenance.
* Ability to complete month\-end close, identify discrepancies, and correct accounting errors.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for financial tracking and reporting.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to meet deadlines while working remotely.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills.
* U.S. residency and authorization to work in the United States.

Pay: $62,956\.46 \- $79,797\.03 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Paid training
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**Overview**



Fetch is a fast\-growing, venture\-backed company transforming the way multifamily communities manage essential amenities. Founded to solve the challenges of package delivery, Fetch has expanded its offerings into four core services: **Package Delivery**, **Valet Trash**, **Fetch Market**, and **Fetch Storage**.  

  

From our local facilities, we ensure secure, convenient, direct\-to\-door delivery for residents while streamlining operations for property teams. Our valet trash service provides simple, community\-wide waste solutions. Fetch Market offers direct\-to\-door delivery of everyday essentials, giving residents unparalleled convenience. Fetch Storage extends our mission by offering secure, flexible storage options tailored to multifamily living.  

  

Operating in communities across the U.S., we are tackling complex logistical challenges every day, from last\-mile delivery to amenity innovation, while creating seamless living experiences for residents and measurable value for property managers and owners. With substantial growth ahead, Fetch continues to shape the future of multifamily living by combining technology, logistics, and hospitality into one cohesive platform.



The Resident Support Team Lead serves as an operational anchor, bridging frontline support agents and department leadership. This role balances direct, hands\-on customer engagement (working queues and managing complex escalations) with day\-to\-day floor oversight, queue governance, peer coaching, and cross\-functional operational support.



### **Job Responsibilities:**

### **Direct Resident Support \& Escalation Management**


* **Work Inbound Queues:** Actively handle inbound customer inquiries across primary support channels (chat, email, phone, ticketing) during high\-volume periods, coverage gaps, or designated operational shifts to maintain deep subject matter expertise.
* **Executive \& Advanced Escalations:** Act as the primary escalation point for complex, sensitive, high\-priority, or leadership\-level customer complaints, resolving issues with empathy, speed, and authority.
* **Root\-Cause Investigation:** Conduct end\-to\-end reviews of account histories, transaction logs, package metadata, or system errors to diagnose underlying causes (e.g., address/unit registration mismatches, delivery failures, software glitches) and prevent recurring issues.

### **Queue Oversight \& SLA Governance**


* **Real\-Time Queue Monitoring:** Continuously monitor incoming conversation queues across Tier 1, Tier 2, and specialized queues to maintain balanced agent workloads and optimal response times.
* **Routing \& Re\-prioritization:** Verify accurate inquiry categorization and dynamically reassign or reprioritize active tickets during volume spikes to prevent Service Level Agreement (SLA) breaches.
* **Lifecycle \& SLA Audits:** Conduct periodic audits on open, pending, and escalated conversations to enforce resolution standards and maintain consistent customer updates within designated timeframes (e.g., 20\-minute SLA targets or 24\-hour update standards).

### **Floor Oversight, Coaching \& Agent Development**


* **Real\-Time Floor Support:** Maintain active visibility across internal team channels (e.g., Slack, Google Spaces) to answer real\-time agent questions, provide technical guidance, and unblock workflow friction.
* **Quality Audits \& Coaching:** Perform regular interaction audits on representative conversation samples. Facilitate 1:1 coaching sessions, side\-by\-side shadowing, and open office hours to enforce SOP adherence, refine communication tone, and eliminate process shortcuts.
* **Promoting Self\-Reliance:** Model and encourage proper tool and knowledge base usage (such as SOP search techniques) to foster agent independence.

### **Operations, Process \& Cross\-Departmental Support**


* **Process Communication:** Draft and broadcast clear team\-wide announcements regarding standard operating procedures, vendor guidelines, and system updates.
* **Cross\-Departmental Collaboration:** Partner with cross\-functional teams (e.g., Regional/Field Operations, Engineering, Product) to investigate operational incidents (e.g., warehouse issues, account checks) and refine frontline workflows.
* **Task \& Workflow Oversight:** Manage secondary administrative queues, specialized order tasking, facility notifications, and vendor alerts to ensure complete operational execution.

**Performance Analytics, Team Cadence \& Performance Escalations**


* **Team Meetings \& Documentation:** Plan and lead recurring team syncs with structured agendas. Utilize documentation and AI note\-taking tools to log action items, track decisions, and share session notes and recordings with CX Management.
* **Metric Compilation \& Trend Analysis:** Review weekly operational data—including First Response Time (FRT), SLA Compliance %, Inbound Volume, and Average Handle Time (AHT per interaction and lifecycle)—and be prepared to discuss in team syncs and with Managers, highlighting performance trends and suggesting operational tweaks.
* **Documenting Performance Patterns:** Track recurring agent deficiencies (e.g., chronic attendance issues, quality drop\-offs, policy non\-compliance). Escalate documented patterns to CX Management and HR to assist leadership in constructing formal performance management plans.

### **Outage Handling \& Knowledge Base Maintenance**


* **Incident \& Outage Triaging:** Serve as the initial operational point of contact during system outages or technical bugs. Partner with our internal Tech Support contact or the Engineering/Product teams to identify issues, communicate updates to the team, and create standardized macro templates for frontline agents.

**Overview**



Fetch is a fast\-growing, venture\-backed company transforming the way multifamily communities manage essential amenities. Founded to solve the challenges of package delivery, Fetch has expanded its offerings into four core services: **Package Delivery**, **Valet Trash**, **Fetch Market**, and **Fetch Storage**.  

  

From our local facilities, we ensure secure, convenient, direct\-to\-door delivery for residents while streamlining operations for property teams. Our valet trash service provides simple, community\-wide waste solutions. Fetch Market offers direct\-to\-door delivery of everyday essentials, giving residents unparalleled convenience. Fetch Storage extends our mission by offering secure, flexible storage options tailored to multifamily living.  

  

Operating in communities across the U.S., we are tackling complex logistical challenges every day, from last\-mile delivery to amenity innovation, while creating seamless living experiences for residents and measurable value for property managers and owners. With substantial growth ahead, Fetch continues to shape the future of multifamily living by combining technology, logistics, and hospitality into one cohesive platform.



The Resident Support Team Lead serves as an operational anchor, bridging frontline support agents and department leadership. This role balances direct, hands\-on customer engagement (working queues and managing complex escalations) with day\-to\-day floor oversight, queue governance, peer coaching, and cross\-functional operational support.



### **Job Responsibilities:**

### **Direct Resident Support \& Escalation Management**


* **Work Inbound Queues:** Actively handle inbound customer inquiries across primary support channels (chat, email, phone, ticketing) during high\-volume periods, coverage gaps, or designated operational shifts to maintain deep subject matter expertise.
* **Executive \& Advanced Escalations:** Act as the primary escalation point for complex, sensitive, high\-priority, or leadership\-level customer complaints, resolving issues with empathy, speed, and authority.
* **Root\-Cause Investigation:** Conduct end\-to\-end reviews of account histories, transaction logs, package metadata, or system errors to diagnose underlying causes (e.g., address/unit registration mismatches, delivery failures, software glitches) and prevent recurring issues.

### **Queue Oversight \& SLA Governance**


* **Real\-Time Queue Monitoring:** Continuously monitor incoming conversation queues across Tier 1, Tier 2, and specialized queues to maintain balanced agent workloads and optimal response times.
* **Routing \& Re\-prioritization:** Verify accurate inquiry categorization and dynamically reassign or reprioritize active tickets during volume spikes to prevent Service Level Agreement (SLA) breaches.
* **Lifecycle \& SLA Audits:** Conduct periodic audits on open, pending, and escalated conversations to enforce resolution standards and maintain consistent customer updates within designated timeframes (e.g., 20\-minute SLA targets or 24\-hour update standards).

### **Floor Oversight, Coaching \& Agent Development**


* **Real\-Time Floor Support:** Maintain active visibility across internal team channels (e.g., Slack, Google Spaces) to answer real\-time agent questions, provide technical guidance, and unblock workflow friction.
* **Quality Audits \& Coaching:** Perform regular interaction audits on representative conversation samples. Facilitate 1:1 coaching sessions, side\-by\-side shadowing, and open office hours to enforce SOP adherence, refine communication tone, and eliminate process shortcuts.
* **Promoting Self\-Reliance:** Model and encourage proper tool and knowledge base usage (such as SOP search techniques) to foster agent independence.

### **Operations, Process \& Cross\-Departmental Support**


* **Process Communication:** Draft and broadcast clear team\-wide announcements regarding standard operating procedures, vendor guidelines, and system updates.
* **Cross\-Departmental Collaboration:** Partner with cross\-functional teams (e.g., Regional/Field Operations, Engineering, Product) to investigate operational incidents (e.g., warehouse issues, account checks) and refine frontline workflows.
* **Task \& Workflow Oversight:** Manage secondary administrative queues, specialized order tasking, facility notifications, and vendor alerts to ensure complete operational execution.

**Performance Analytics, Team Cadence \& Performance Escalations**


* **Team Meetings \& Documentation:** Plan and lead recurring team syncs with structured agendas. Utilize documentation and AI note\-taking tools to log action items, track decisions, and share session notes and recordings with CX Management.
* **Metric Compilation \& Trend Analysis:** Review weekly operational data—including First Response Time (FRT), SLA Compliance %, Inbound Volume, and Average Handle Time (AHT per interaction and lifecycle)—and be prepared to discuss in team syncs and with Managers, highlighting performance trends and suggesting operational tweaks.
* **Documenting Performance Patterns:** Track recurring agent deficiencies (e.g., chronic attendance issues, quality drop\-offs, policy non\-compliance). Escalate documented patterns to CX Management and HR to assist leadership in constructing formal performance management plans.

### **Outage Handling \& Knowledge Base Maintenance**


* **Incident \& Outage Triaging:** Serve as the initial operational point of contact during system outages or technical bugs. Partner with our internal Tech Support contact or the Engineering/Product teams to identify issues, communicate updates to the team, and create standardized macro templates for frontline agents.
* **SOP \& Knowledge Base Updates:** Regularly review operational procedures and knowledge base articles. Draft updates or flag outdated documentation for management review and approval prior to team rollout.

**About Rippling**

  

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

The Customer Success team (Internally called: Technical Account Manager (TAM)) partners with our largest and most strategic accounts to understand their needs, demonstrate where Rippling can solve their business needs, and ensure retention of key accounts. TAMs own the key admin relationships and are responsible for turning customers into long\-term champions, developing account strategy, and providing enablement and optimization best practices, all while providing an impeccable customer experience along the way.

  

Leading this team will challenge your ability to context\-switch from high level customer strategy to tactical account level escalations to retention opportunities on a daily basis. The ideal candidate is a customer\-obsessed strategist, eager to build and mentor a team of incredible TAMs.

 **Please note:** Employees based in San Francisco Bay Area or New York City Metro will be required to go into office 1\-3 days a week depending on mileage to office.

* Manage a team of highly motivated, customer\-focused TAMs to ensure the overall health and satisfaction of strategic accounts in our broker partner channel
* + Thought partner with TAMs and build playbooks for effective customer strategy
	+ Develop senior\-level relationships with customers
	+ Serve as a point of escalation for team’s accounts
	+ Ensure the team is trained and confident in Rippling product capabilities
	+ Own ongoing TAM account assignments
	+ Participate in recruiting process, from sourcing to hire
	+ Drive customer adoption of key features and best practices
	+ Meet with team members weekly to stay close on updates for key accounts
	+ Performance manage to ensure your team’s success
* Partner cross\-functionally to advocate for your team’s customer and partner needs

	+ Partner with Support to mitigate escalations

* Build TAM team processes and culture
* + Measure team impact and prioritize CX lifecycle events
	+ Constantly iterate and improve TAM workflows and optimize process inefficiencies
	+ Collaborate with leadership team on quarterly kickoffs, offsites, team building events, and more to foster a strong team culture

**What you will need**

* 5\+ years of SaaS experience in customer\-facing role
* 2\+ years of management experience; passion for supporting and guiding a team’s growth, career progress, and job performance
* Expertise in account management and customer success best practices
* Ruthless prioritization and time management
* Boundless energy to help your team and your customers...all with a “can\-do” attitude!
* Strong attention to detail and ability to solve complex, interdependent problems
* Flexibility to thrive in a fast paced organization with dynamic responsibilities

Anomali, headquartered in Silicon Valley, delivers the first Intelligence\-Native Agentic SOC Platform — unifying a security data lake, the world's largest IOC repository, threat intelligence, and agentic AI into a single modern experience. The platform accelerates detection, investigation, and response, delivering earlier insights, faster action, and scalable modernization across any environment.



Whether augmenting existing tools or delivering complete SOC capabilities end\-to\-end, Anomali empowers security teams to operate faster, smarter, and with confidence.



Beyond Detecting. Start Deciding. Start Acting.



Learn more at www.anomali.com.

**Job Description:**
We are looking for a dedicated, ambitious, curious and self\-driven Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) to join the US Customer Success team. The TAM is the most accountable individual for a customer's adoption journey \- end to end, from onboarding through full production use. You will pair deep technical fluency with the executive presence to build lasting relationships with analysts, directors, and CISOs, and you'll own the cadence of QBRs/EBRs that turn technical wins into renewed and expanded business.

Identify expansion and renewal risk signals from usage data and stakeholder relationships, surfacing them to CSM/AE partners

o Partner with Sales to ensure an exceptional customer experience

* Demonstrated experience presenting to and building trust with senior security leadership (Director/VP/CISO level), including running QBRs/ERs that connect technical adoption to business outcomes

  

* Customer\-first attitude; a listener who is customer\-oriented and attentive to their needs

  

* Proven experience (5\+ years) in a technical customer success, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or similar role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company with experience in cybersecurity technologies and architectures including coverage areas:

  

o SOAR  

  

o SIEM

United States \- Remote


Customer Success/Full time/Remote

  



Role Overview  

The Analytics Specialist owns the success and growth of a dedicated portfolio of Guidewire Analytics clients. Combining customer success, analytics expertise and commercial account ownership, the role helps clients turn Guidewire's data and analytics capabilities into practical business value while driving adoption, retention and growth.  

Guidewire's Analytics portfolio includes predictive modelling, high\-resolution property and hazard data, cyber risk modelling, pooled and anonymised P\&C data and predictive scores, as well as business intelligence capabilities including interactive dashboards and reporting.


**Job Description**

### **Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Own the Client Portfolio: Manage a portfolio of Analytics clients across the full lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption through value realisation, renewal and expansion. Maintain a clear view of client objectives, usage, account health, risks and opportunities, and take ownership of moving the relationship forward.
* Turn Client Challenges into Analytics Use Cases: Understand the decisions, workflows and business problems clients are trying to improve and identify how Guidewire's data and analytics capabilities can help. Translate sometimes ambiguous requirements into practical use cases and support clients in embedding these capabilities into their processes.
* Drive Retention and Commercial Growth: Manage renewal readiness and proactively identify retention risks, working with clients and internal teams to address them. Partner with Sales and Portfolio Leaders to identify and develop credible expansion and cross\-sell opportunities based on client needs, product usage and emerging use cases.
* Lead Client Engagement: Build trusted relationships across business, technical and executive stakeholders. Navigate complex client organisations, identify decision\-makers and champions, manage challenging conversations and provide guidance on how clients can maximise the value of Guidewire Analytics.
* Mobilise Guidewire Around the Client: Bring together Product, Sales, Support, Professional Services and other specialists to resolve issues and advance client objectives. Represent client needs internally, communicate product gaps and emerging requirements, and help connect client priorities with Guidewire's capabilities and product direction.
* Build and Expertise: Develop strong knowledge of Guidewire's Analytics portfolio and relevant data and risk domains. successful use cases and best practices across the client portfolio and contribute to client events, industry discussions and the continued development of Guidewire's Analytics proposition.

### **Experience \& Skills**

* Client and commercial experience: Five or more years in customer success, consulting, sales, account management or a similar client\-facing role, with experience owning complex client relationships and commercial outcomes.
* Data and analytical mindset: Experience working with data, analytics or technology solutions and an ability to understand how data can be applied to business decisions. Experience with weather, natural hazard, property, geospatial, environmental or other risk\-related data is particularly valuable.
* Consultative problem solving: Able to ask the right questions, structure complex or unclear problems and turn business requirements into actionable solutions.
* Technical curiosity: Comfortable discussing APIs, datasets, integrations, analytical models and dashboards without needing to be a software engineer or data scientist.
* Commercial judgement: Able to recognise client risk and growth opportunities, balance client and commercial priorities and confidently navigate renewal, usage and expansion conversations.
* Adaptability and ownership: Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment where products, processes and requirements continue to evolve. Able to make pragmatic decisions with incomplete information, take initiative and adapt quickly as priorities change.
* Influence and collaboration: Able to build credibility with senior, business and technical stakeholders and mobilise people across different teams without direct authority.
* Learning agility: Curious and able to quickly build knowledge of new products, datasets, technologies and use cases. P\&C insurance experience is welcome but not required; familiarity with the use of data in risk selection, pricing, underwriting or claims is advantageous.


The role requires travel to client locations, Guidewire offices and industry events as appropriate

  

The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $114,000 \- $192,000\. Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. All full\-time positions or part\-time roles working 30 hours or more a week at Guidewire are eligible for benefits that support their health and well\-being including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a company sponsored retirement plan. In addition, some roles may be eligible for the annual company bonus plan, commissions, and/or long term incentive awards which are contingent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, company and employee performance.

* Analyze transaction trends and volumes for assigned functions, identify drivers of exceptions/contacts, and recommend process improvements to reduce repeat issues and improve throughput and accuracy

* Tier II Phone Support:
* + Serve as a first and primary point of contact to Tier II phone support calls for the Deposit Operations department, delivering timely internal support, troubleshooting, and issue triage
* Analyze Tier II support trends (contact drivers, repeat issues, error patterns), and recommend systemic or holistic improvements to reduce routine support needs through better procedures, job aids, and/or upstream fixes
* Escalations, Collaboration, and Knowledge Sharing:
* + Assess risk trends and control effectiveness for owned functions, identifying emerging issues and recommending corrective actions to reduce operational, financial, and regulatory exposure
* Provide analytical support to escalations, including root\-cause identification and recommended solutions.
* Share insights, reporting, and best practices with peers and leaders; collaborate cross\-functionally to resolve recurring issues and improve service and controls
* Participate in service and process improvement initiatives by identifying inefficiencies and recommending enhancements to operational workflows and controls
* Additional Responsibilities:
* + Support special projects and implementation activities for new procedures, controls, or technologies as assigned
* Comply with all bank policies, audit standards, regulatory mandates, and all required compliance training.
* Perform other duties as assigned
### **QUALIFICATIONS:**



* High School Diploma required, Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* National Check Professional (NCP) accreditation preferred
* Minimum of 3 years of bank operations experience required; 5\+ years of experience or more years preferred
* Prior item/check/payment processing experience preferred
* Demonstrated problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, recommend systemic fixes, and support prevention strategies
* Strong working knowledge of applicable regulations; ability to identify potential compliance issues and support regulatory analysis, exams, and reporting
* Functional knowledge/understanding of accounting concepts and process preferred
* Experience working in a fast paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Proficiency in the use of PC software tools for reports, audits, and analysis
* Ability to establish positive working relationships and collaboration across the organization
* Requires ability to work with minimal supervision
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Outstanding problem\-solving and time management skills

In the coming decades, our world needs far more critical minerals including copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. KoBold is the leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology.  **Job Description**  

The Clinical Data Strategy and Operations (CDSO) DMO Lead or Clinical Data Scientist (CDS) serves as the data management domain expert and key strategic partner to the clinical study team. This role owns the data collection strategy, drives implementation, oversees data quality delivery, and supports on\-time achievement of key study milestones. As the Data Operations single point of contact for cross\-functional stakeholders, the DMO Lead or CDS applies strong project management, risk oversight, and continuous process optimization to enable data quality, inspection readiness, and successful trial delivery.


Responsibilities:

* Serves as the CDSO data management subject matter expert and single point of contact for assigned studies, owning data collection, data cleaning, and database lock strategies to enable high\-quality, inspection\-ready study delivery.
* Leads risk\-based and continuous data review strategies from study start\-up through database lock, leveraging centralized monitoring, statistical review, and clinical data science methodologies to proactively identify and mitigate study risks.
* Triages data quality standards across studies to identify trends, drive site\-level actions through effective cross\-functional communication, and maintain data currency in support of timely, reliable study decisions.
* Interprets clinical and operational data, quality metrics, predictive signals, and dashboard outputs to develop data\-driven recommendations that strengthen study execution, risk management, patient safety oversight, and quality across the clinical development lifecycle.
* Contributes to defining, managing, and monitoring data\-driven protocol deviations.
* Defines and manages study data flow and triages issues from raw EDC data through mapped SDTM data, partnering with internal technology teams, service providers, and vendors to drive timely mitigation and support end\-to\-end data integrity.
* Performs data mining and custom analytics, gathers business requirements for study dashboards, and generates operational metrics that support study decisions.
* Ensures adherence to federal and applicable local regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie SOPs, and functional quality standards; stays abreast of evolving guidance.
* Influences cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority, aligning clinical, statistical, medical, safety, regulatory, technology, and vendor organizations around data\-driven decisions and clinical data science strategies.
* Leads CDSO innovation and process improvement initiatives and participates in cross\-functional efforts that improve operational effectiveness, scalability, and study delivery quality.
* Coaches and mentors team members.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, management information systems, computer science, life sciences or equivalent. Masters preferred.

* Demonstrated performance as a functional leader
* Demonstrated ability to influence others without direct authority
* Demonstrated ability to successfully coach / mentor in a matrix environment
* Demonstrated effective communication skills
* Demonstrated effective analytical skills

Sunnyvale, California, United States


**Category** General Management **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18753 **Base Salary Range** $117000\-$176000 **Date posted** 09/15/2026
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years turning ambiguity into action, and you know the difference between a program that runs itself and one that needs constant rescue. The work that excites you is not the big announcement, it is the mechanism behind it: the review that surfaces the right decision, the tracker that keeps ten leaders aligned, the agenda that turns a two\-hour meeting into a thirty\-minute one with clear next steps.


You are the person who walks into a room where three teams think they are aligned and quietly realizes they are not, then fixes it without drama. You do not need perfect information to move. You ask the right questions, map what matters, and build the structure that lets other people do their best work. When a senior leader says "we need to get our arms around this," you are already drafting the plan.


You have run operating rhythms before, not just participated in them. You know what makes a quarterly business review actually useful versus performative. You are comfortable holding a VP to a deadline and equally comfortable absorbing the work no one else sees. At Synopsys, you will work directly with the Chief IP Development Office and own the programs that keep two major engineering organizations moving forward.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Own the full lifecycle of strategic programs across IPG and SSG, from scoping and planning through execution and closure, including tracking milestones, dependencies, and commitments across leadership
* Run the operating rhythm of the Executive Office: strategic account reviews, staff meetings, all\-hands forums, quarterly business reviews, and leadership check\-ins, including agenda design, pre\-reads, minutes, action tracking, and follow\-up
* Build and maintain dashboards, status reports, and executive summaries that leadership uses to track progress and make decisions, working across teams to ensure consistency and accuracy
* Prepare the CIDO and leadership team for reviews and planning cycles by assembling agendas, data, and materials that are clear, accurate, and ready to use
* Drive cross\-functional action items to closure, coordinating across engineering, product management, finance, and HR to keep commitments on track
* Improve how the office operates by refining existing mechanisms and standing up new ones as the organization scales
* Partner with the CIDO's Executive Assistant on scheduling, logistics, and day\-to\-day coordination for leadership meetings, off\-sites, and large events across multiple time zones

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Leadership decisions move faster and with better information because the reviews you run surface the right data at the right time
* Cross\-organizational commitments close on schedule because you track them, follow up, and hold owners accountable without letting things slip
* Senior leaders spend less time chasing status and more time on strategy because the reporting you build is consistent, accurate, and easy to consume
* The Executive Office becomes a model for how an engineering organization should operate, with mechanisms that scale as IPG and SSG grow
* Programs that would otherwise stall in ambiguity move forward because you bring structure, clarity, and follow\-through
* The CIDO and leadership team are prepared for every review, every planning cycle, and every decision point because you have done the work to make them ready
* Junior program managers and coordinators learn how to run programs well because you mentor them and set the standard

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years in program management, project management, or business operations, or an advanced degree and 3\+ years of related experience
* A track record of running multiple workstreams concurrently and delivering them on schedule without needing to be chased
* Strong written communication skills, specifically the ability to turn a complex discussion into a concise summary a senior executive can act on
* Sound judgment about what to escalate, what to decide yourself, and what to absorb so leadership can focus on higher\-level work
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 including Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint
* 8\+ years of program management or operations experience is a plus, as is experience supporting an executive staff in a large engineering or technology organization
* Experience standing up an operating process from scratch, not just running one that already exists, is a strong differentiator
* Semiconductor, EDA, or silicon IP background is valuable but not required

Hands\-on use of program management tools like Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, or MS Project is helpful, as is experience * ing AI productivity tools to daily operations

### **Who You Are**

* You see what needs doing and start, rather than waiting for someone to assign it to you, and you follow through until it is closed
* Commitments, dates, and numbers are right the first time because you check your work and you understand that details matter when leadership is making decisions
* You stay calm and effective when priorities shift on short notice, and you can hold multiple threads in your head without losing track of any of them
* You are credible with senior people and comfortable holding a VP to a deadline or pushing back when a plan is missing

Under the leadership and supervision of OTOP’s Intake \& Counseling Services Director, the Clinical Case Manager\- MAJIC/Intake will play a key role in providing patients with culturally responsive, trauma\-informed, person\-centered counseling services, assessments and case management support. **Be the first point of care—guiding patients through admission with accuracy, compassion, and confidence while ensuring every detail of their visit is handled seamlessly.**



At SimonMed Imaging, the patient experience starts long before an exam takes place. Our Patient Service Specialists play a critical role in facilitating the patient admission flow across our imaging centers. From greeting patients to verifying insurance and processing documentation, this role ensures each visit starts with clarity, efficiency, and care.



We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, communicates with empathy, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service. If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and being part of a collaborative healthcare team, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.


### **What You Bring**

**A patient\-first mindset:** You treat every interaction with empathy, respect, and genuine concern for patient needs.


**Strong communication and team\-oriented approach:** You communicate clearly, listen actively, support patients and teams with professionalism and empathy, and contribute to smooth, collaborative front desk operations.


**Attention to detail:** You accurately collect, process, and maintain patient demographics, insurance information, medical histories, consent forms, and payments with accuracy and care.


**Adaptability and composure:** You stay calm under pressure in high\-volume environments, manage competing priorities, and handle sensitive or challenging situations with professionalism.


**Reliability, accountability, and problem\-solving:** You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, consistently arrive prepared and ready to support the team, contribute to a positive culture, and help resolve scheduling, billing, and patient flow issues while maintaining a positive patient experience.

### **What You'll Gain**

**Purpose\-driven work:** Your role is essential to patient care, ensuring every individual is welcomed, supported, and guided through a smooth and compassionate access experience from the very start of their visit.


**A collaborative team environment:** Partner with clinical, operational, and support teams focused on delivering exceptional patient experiences.


**Growth opportunities:** Gain experience in healthcare operations, patient access, and medical administration within a growing organization.

### **You're a Strong Fit if You Have**

* 1\+ years of customer service, patient access, medical office, or call center experience preferred


* Experience with scheduling, insurance verification, or healthcare registration processes preferred


* Strong computer and data entry skills


* Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


* Experience working with EMR/PM systems preferred


* High school diploma or equivalent required

### **Benefits**



Your health, happiness and future matters!



At SimonMed Imaging, we offer:


* We believe in preventative care for everyone including our team – SimonMed provides free, whole\-body scans to each member


* Competitive wages


* No nights/no calls/no weekends


* Cross training opportunities


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance


* 401(k) eligibility


* Pet Insurance


* Paid holidays


* PTO


* Sick Time



We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. new_jobs.title: Salesforce Patient Services Architect
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description Overview**


Accenture's Salesforce Business Group is seeking a Salesforce Life Sciences Functional Architect. In this role you lead the functional design of a defined workstream or capability area within a larger Salesforce Life Sciences program — running requirements and design sessions, translating business processes into platform solutions, and making day\-to\-day design decisions within the architecture direction set by senior architecture leadership. You will work directly with client business owners and product owners, guide a team of functional analysts and configurators, and partner closely with technical leads to see your designs through to delivery.

 **We Are:**


Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 790,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world's leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day. Visit us at www.accenture.com.

 **You Are:**


You will join Accenture's Salesforce Business Group — one of the largest and most experienced Salesforce practices in the world. We have been building on this platform since the beginning, which means we have seen what works, what doesn't, and how to deliver at scale. We are Master Certified across all 12 industries and clouds, and our team holds over 4,200 certifications including Certified Technical Architect (CTA). In Life Sciences specifically, we bring deep domain knowledge alongside our Salesforce expertise — helping pharmaceutical, biotech and MedTech clients modernize commercial operations, improve patient and HCP engagement, and build the platforms that power their next phase of growth. We invest in our people through ongoing training, specialization paths and a culture of continuous learning.

  

As a Salesforce Life Sciences Functional Architect at the, you are a hands\-on functional leader who is trusted to own a workstream end to end. You are equally credible in a client workshop and in a design review, and you are comfortable making decisions in your domain while knowing when to escalate. You bring practical Life Sciences knowledge — how commercial teams, patient services and medical affairs actually operate — and you use it to challenge assumptions and shape better solutions. You take pride in the quality of your designs, and you are ready to grow into a broader architecture leadership role.

 **The Work:**

* Own the functional solution design for an assigned workstream or capability area within a Salesforce Life Sciences program, working within the overall architecture direction set by senior architecture leadership
* Lead design workshops with client business and product owners, and translate outcomes into user stories, functional specifications and technical designs
* Configure and demonstrate Salesforce Life Sciences capabilities, building prototypes and running solution walkthroughs to validate design decisions with stakeholders
* Make day\-to\-day design decisions within your domain, document trade\-offs and rationale, and escalate cross\-workstream or platform\-wide decisions to the lead architect
* Partner with technical leads and developers to ensure designs are buildable, and support estimation, sprint planning, backlog grooming and defect triage
* Guide and review the work of functional analysts, configurators and offshore team members, providing coaching and quality oversight on deliverables
* Contribute to architecture governance and design reviews by preparing materials, presenting your workstream's approach and applying agreed standards consistently
* Support testing, data migration, training and deployment activities for your workstream, and help drive user adoption post go\-live
* Contribute to proposals, demonstrations and estimates during pursuits, and help build reusable assets and accelerators for the Life Sciences practice
* Identify and raise design, scope and delivery risks within your workstream, and work with leadership on mitigation

  

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of Salesforce experience in a functional design, business analysis or solution consulting capacity
* Minimum of 3 years of experience delivering Salesforce solutions for Life Sciences clients or another regulated industry
* Minimum of 1 year of experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Patient services experience
* Minimum of 1 year of Salesforce Life Sciences experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

**Bonus Points If:**

* Life Sciences Cloud / Health Cloud data model, security model and declarative configuration
* Commercial and HCP engagement processes such as account and territory management, call planning and omnichannel engagement
* Patient services processes such as enrollment, benefits verification, adherence and case management
* Medical affairs and MSL engagement, including adverse event capture and downstream handoffs
* Familiarity with integration concepts across CRM, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud and external data sources
* Awareness of regulatory and compliance considerations such as GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA and global privacy requirements
* You hold Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Sales Cloud or Service C

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. As a Salesforce Life Sciences Functional Architect at the, you are a hands\-on functional leader who is trusted to own a workstream end to end. You are equally credible in a client workshop and in a design review, and you are comfortable making decisions in your domain while knowing when to escalate. You bring practical Life Sciences knowledge — how commercial teams, patient services and medical affairs actually operate — and you use it to challenge assumptions and shape better solutions. You take pride in the quality of your designs, and you are ready to grow into a broader architecture leadership role.

 **The Work:**

* Own the functional solution design for an assigned workstream or capability area within a Salesforce Life Sciences program, working within the overall architecture direction set by senior architecture leadership
* Lead design workshops with client business and product owners, and translate outcomes into user stories, functional specifications and technical designs
* Configure and demonstrate Salesforce Life Sciences capabilities, building prototypes and running solution walkthroughs to validate design decisions with stakeholders
* Make day\-to\-day design decisions within your domain, document trade\-offs and rationale, and escalate cross\-workstream or platform\-wide decisions to the lead architect

* Support testing, data migration, training and deployment activities for your workstream, and help drive user adoption post go\-live
* Contribute to proposals, demonstrations and estimates during pursuits, and help build reusable assets and accelerators for the Life Sciences practice
* Identify and raise design, scope and delivery risks within your workstream, and work with leadership on mitigation

  

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of Salesforce experience in a functional design, business analysis or solution consulting capacity
* Minimum of 3 years of experience delivering Salesforce solutions for Life Sciences clients or another regulated industry
* Minimum of 1 year of experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Patient services experience
* Minimum of 1 year of Salesforce Life Sciences experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

**Bonus Points If:**

* Life Sciences Cloud / Health Cloud data model, security model and declarative configuration
* Commercial and HCP engagement processes such as account and territory management, call planning and omnichannel engagement
* Patient services processes such as enrollment, benefits verification, adherence and case management
* Medical affairs and MSL engagement, including adverse event capture and downstream handoffs
* Familiarity with integration concepts across CRM, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud and external data sources
* Awareness of regulatory and compliance considerations such as GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA and global privacy requirements
* You hold Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Sales Cloud or Service C

The Law Enforcement Operations team is a global function responsible for building and maintaining trusted relationships with law enforcement authorities across the world. This is done through strategic engagement with law enforcement authorities both on a proactive and reactive basis. The team also undertakes awareness\-raising initiatives to educate and train authorities on our processes and policies regarding data disclosure and investigative support through a strict legal and privacy\-focused framework.
  
  

As a Law Enforcement Outreach Manager, you will be the liaison officer to strategic law enforcement agencies in the Americas Region, with a specific focus on Canada and Central America. This position would entail frequent travel to countries in the region.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* You'll work closely with legal and public policy teams to develop key partnerships between TikTok and strategic law enforcement agencies with a focus on Internet safety and security.
* You'll develop proactive outreach programs to law enforcement agencies in AMS, to raise awareness on TikTok processes such as submissions of emergency data disclosure requests, other requests relating to data, and TikTok’s policies for protecting user privacy and responding to legal requests.

* You'll work closely with our internal legal team and external counsel in responding to governmental requests for data.

* Experienced in working or engaging with law enforcement authorities at an international level.

#### **About the Job:**



The Manager of Digital Customer Success will report to the Director of Customer Success, Americas, and lead a team of Digital CSMs who serve as the primary post\-sale point of contact for LaunchDarkly's largest subset of customers. The ideal candidate is a people\-first leader who is passionate about delivering an exceptional customer experience, brings an innovative approach to Customer Success, and thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. This role is a unique opportunity to shape and lead a team in a growing market at LaunchDarkly, driving both customer success and organizational growth.


#### **Responsibilities:**


* **Team Leadership and Development:** Recruit, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of CSMs. Provide ongoing coaching, support, and feedback to help the team grow their skills, deliver strong customer outcomes, and consistently meet or exceed expectations.
* **Scaled Strategy and Execution:** Partner closely with the GTM ecosystem and other CS teams to build and operationalize Customer Success programs and playbooks tailored to the Digital customer segment, ensuring alignment with our global CS frameworks.
* **Proactive Customer Insight:** Enable the team to understand and act early on leading indicators such as onboarding progress, product adoption, risk signals, and expansion potential, in order to reduce churn and drive growth.
* **Operational Execution:** Bring operational rigor to the team by organizing around key performance metrics, including NDR and expansion, and running regular forecast and pipeline reviews to ensure we deliver against both short\- and long\-term goals.
* **Customer Engagement:** Serve as the senior advocate for strategic and high\-impact customers. Oversee critical engagements and escalations, and ensure customer needs and insights inform internal decisions. LaunchDarkly is a startup environment, and everyone stays close to customers.

#### **About You:**


* **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high\-performing teams.
* **Entrepreneurial Spirit:** Driven, proactive, and comfortable operating in a highly ambiguous, startup environment.
* **Passion for Growth (your own, and your teams):** Enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development. Actively seeks and provides feedback. You consider promoting a team member the best deal you could possibly close!
* **Analytical:** Enjoys identifying trends in data and making informed decisions about team and customer outcomes.
* **Program Builder:** Passionate about building high\-impact, customer focused programs. Able to build and execute a project plan, holding stakeholders accountable to a timeline.

* **Team Player:** Collaborates well with others, knows when to involve other stakeholders, and proactively keeps others informed.

#### **Qualifications:**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Experience owning the renewal process and being accountable for a retention quota. Strong discovery, qualification, and sales skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC, or similar methodologies is preferred.
* **Data Orientation:** Experience leveraging data to make decisions about talent, team effectiveness, customer programs, etc.

new_jobs.title: Business Operations & Customer Service Advisor
new_jobs.description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**YOUR ROLE**

Be the primary interface between customers and ST for operational communications, demand fulfillment, forecast alignment, supply execution and service performance through best\-in\-class customer service.


Pro\-actively act as the official and reliable information source for customer demand and execution constraints.  



**Customer orders \& executions management**

* Manage order lifecycle (firm orders, NRE POs, samples), including contract and pricing set up
* Maintain and optimize backlog: update requests, monitor confirmations \& deliveries. Capture customer signals to improve forecast accuracy, as applicable.
* Ensure adherence to the agreed terms (RD changes, inventory control) and drive issue resolution working with divisions and supply chain organizations
* Provide the short\-term manufacturing request through customer delivery forecasts, operational demand management, complimenting customer POs, as applicable.
* Achieve revenue plans by driving optimal backlog coverage, working in close partnership with the customer, sales and champions
* Support billing and shipping requirements in coordination with Finance, Logistics, and Trade Compliance
* Ensure disciplined last\-mile execution to achieve quarter\-end billing targets (e.g. JIT, DSI)

**Supply \& Logistics Management**

* Translate key supply drivers (internal/ external inventory, GITs, constrained demand, PLDs, demand layering) into a clear and reliable supply commitment to customer through capacity visibility, quality service setup, and in alignment with sourcing agreement obligations.
* Manage consignment and buffer stock agreement (VMI contracts, LTI agreements)

* Proactively manage shipment risks: resolve delays, expedite urgent shipments, address customs issues, and manage trade compliance requirements

* Oversee customer set up, following the governance standards and customer requirements

**Customer communication \& Escalation**

* Lead customer communication on operational topics (lead\-time, delivery status, improvement)
* Support direct customer or distributor inquiries (claims, RMAs, compliance data, documentation)
* Partner closely with the respective sales team, manage escalations, ensuring timely resolution through prompt communication

**Capacity \& Constraint Outlook**

* Develop and communicate forward\-looking supply outlooks aligned with allocation and capacity
* Define mitigation strategies and product mix scenarios during constraints

**YOUR SKILLS \& EXPERIENCES**

* Experienced operations leader with 10\-15 years of expertise in sales processes, demand and supply management, and customer service
* Strong understanding of supply chain principles, processes, and best practices, with the ability to support efficient planning, coordination, and execution across the value chain.
* Collaborative partner with business operations, sales, finance, divisions, and supply chain teams.

We bring together the best engineering talent working with the most advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. ### **Role Overview:**


Egen is looking for a strategic and client\-facing Senior Consultant, Agentic Change Enablement to lead high\-impact transformations. This role serves as the human\-side anchor on engagements where technology is only part of the story. You will embed with client project teams to ensure employees at every level are prepared, equipped, and motivated to adopt new ways of working powered by Google Cloud, Gemini, and the emerging "agentic work" paradigm. * Executive Coaching: Support and engage senior leaders and executive sponsors, coaching them on their visible change leadership role.

* Curriculum Design: Develop persona\-based learning journeys and role\-based training programs that build competency in agentic solutions.

#### **4\. Adoption Measurement \& Sustainment**


* Pilot Implementation: Lead Gemini Enterprise Pilot programs, managing Vanguard Cohorts and capturing baseline productivity reports.
* Support Infrastructure: Establish multi\-layered support systems, including Slack/Teams channels, office hours, and deployed self\-service support agents.
* Sustainment: Conduct post\-go\-live reinforcement activities and pulse check surveys to embed new behaviors permanently.
* Reporting: Generate weekly usage and adoption reports for project stakeholders and client leadership.
### **About you:**


#### **Required**


* Experience: 3–6\+ years in organizational change management or management consulting, with a focus on enterprise\-scale technology programs.
* Methodology: Proven proficiency with change management frameworks; Prosci (ADKAR) certification is strongly preferred.
* Technology Background: Experience supporting cloud or SaaS adoption programs (Google Workspace, Google Cloud, or equivalent).
* Communication: Exceptional skills in crafting narratives and presenting to everyone from end users to C\-suite executives.
* Engagement: Strong stakeholder management capabilities with experience influencing across complex organizations.

#### **Preferred**


* AI Expertise: Hands\-on experience with Generative AI adoption (e.g., Gemini for Google Workspace or Vertex AI).

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Insights Program Management
new_jobs.description:
We're hiring a Senior Manager, Implementation Program Manager to own the delivery and relationship for a portfolio of Tendo Insights customers, from contract signature through go\-live and into steady\-state value realization. You'll be the person a hospital's CMO, CFO, and clinical documentation team all trust to bring order to a complex, cross\-functional rollout — one that touches clinical, financial, IT, and executive stakeholders who don't always agree with each other.



This is a senior, largely autonomous role. You'll be expected to build and run your own implementation plans, manage multiple concurrent customer engagements, navigate organizational politics inside customer accounts, and represent Tendo credibly in front of hospital executives while also partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Support to make sure customer commitments are realistic and kept.  

  

**About Tendo**



Make an impact—join our team!  

  

We’re a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company building a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive. **Our team\-driven culture and rapid growth have** **earned us recognition as one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers for 2024, 2025, and 2026\.** Led by an experienced and proven team, we live by our values and are always on the hunt for motivated people with diverse experiences and backgrounds to help us improve the care journey for patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user\-friendly experiences.  

  

If you like working with innovative technologies and want to be part of a growing team that will help transform the healthcare experience, we encourage you to apply today!  

  

**Job Location**



Remote



Tendo has hubs in San Francisco, CA; Salt Lake City, UT; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and Philadelphia, PA. Candidates may be located in any one of our hub locations.



\#LI\-Remote



### **Responsibilities**


* Own end\-to\-end implementation planning for new Tendo Insights customers — building phased project plans, governance structures, and realistic timelines based on each customer's specific data, IT, and organizational constraints.
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts through implementation, building trusted\-advisor relationships with executive sponsors (CMO/CFO\-level), day\-to\-day champions, and operational stakeholders (CDI, HIM, IT/data teams).
* Identify and proactively manage delivery risk — including organizational and interpersonal risk (e.g., a stakeholder who sees the tool as a threat, competing internal IT priorities) and not just timeline/technical risk.
* Run structured stakeholder communication and escalation cadences, including managing engagements through periods when an executive sponsor has reduced availability.
* Convert high\-level or phased contract commitments into specific, mutually agreed implementation plans with the customer.Build and deliver executive\-level updates and business reviews that connect implementation progress to the value the customer actually cares about — including proposing credible leading indicators when the metrics customers ultimately care about (like annual quality rankings) move too slowly to show in\-quarter progress.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales (on scoping and handoff), Product (on customer feedback and gaps), and Support (on transition to steady state) to ensure a seamless customer experience.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer engagements at varying stages of the implementation lifecycle, prioritizing your time across a portfolio rather than a single account.
* Mentor and provide guidance to more junior program/project managers on the team as it scales.
### **Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in program/project management, implementation, or professional services, ideally in enterprise software, healthcare technology, or a comparably complex B2B environment.
* A track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder implementations with executive\-level customer visibility — not just internal project plans.
* Demonstrated judgment in navigating organizational politics and relationship risk within a customer account — you can name the real risk to an engagement, not just the risk that's easy to put in a status report.
* Strong executive communication and presence — comfortable building and delivering a plan or business review directly to a customer's C\-suite, and comfortable being challenged on it in the room.
* Structured, rigorous planning skills: you can build a realistic, dependency\-aware timeline rather than a generic template.
* Experience managing a portfolio of concurrent engagements and prioritizing across competing demands.
### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in healthcare — particularly with hospital or health system operations, clinical quality programs, clinical documentation improvement (CDI), or healthcare data/analytics.
* Familiarity with healthcare quality metrics and ranking programs (e.g., CMS Star Ratings, U.S. News \& World Report rankings, HEDIS, or similar).
* PMP, PgMP, or similar program management certification.
* Experience partnering with clinical, IT, and finance stakeholders simultaneously on the same engagement.

  


**Base Salary Range**



$114,750 \- $155,250



This salary range is offered with the understanding that final compensation is based on a number of factors including geography and experience. Tendo also offers an equity package, annual bonuses, and benefits.

  


**Benefits**



For full time employees, Tendo also offers full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending and health savings accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short\-term and long\-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k), company paid holidays, flexible time off, and an employee wellness program (“Breathe”).
